BreakBoss is a drum machine for iPad and iPhone that runs on its own or as an AUv3 plug-in inside your DAW. It has 12 pads, four faceplates (Modern, Vintage, Texture and Platinum), a full drum roll with a piano-roll lane for the 808, hundreds of kits and pattern presets across trap, drill, RnB, boom bap, jazz, soul, amapiano and more, plus MIDI out so you can record pads and patterns straight into your DAW.
